description: This file is a Perl test script using Test2::V0 to verify the behavior of purchase list and dish ingredient functionalities in a database-backed application. It tests methods like assigning ingredients to purchase lists, converting units, and removing ingredients from purchase lists.

classes.name: TestDB
classes.description: A test database interface providing access to various result sets.

methods.name: article_has_items
methods.description: A helper function that verifies the items of an article match an expected string, by concatenating item values and units.

methods.name: assign_to_purchase_list
methods.description: Method to assign a dish ingredient to a purchase list.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Method to convert an item to a different unit.

methods.name: remove_from_purchase_list
methods.description: Method to remove a dish ingredient from a purchase list.

methods.name: discard_changes
methods.description: Method to discard uncommitted changes to an object.
